Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Chris" <cbo...@apdi.net> wrote:
>
> What is the current ruling on this card [Sleeping Mind]?

> I seem to remember reading that a defending vampire can
> play WWEF to block. Yet, the card specifically states that
> 'tapped vampires cannot block this action'. I couldn't find
> anything on this card on your site or via Deja News.
> I'm kinda curious and would like you to refresh my failing
> memory.

You can play WwEF, but you can't block (since you're still tapped,
and tapped vampire cannot block).

You can Wake and play a reaction card (like Deflection or Telepathic
Counter, for example).

The original ruling was:

Subject: Re: More Questions [LSJ]
From: "L. Scott Johnson" <vte...@regency.wizards.com>
Date: 1997/06/03
Message-Id: <33946F...@regency.wizards.com>

[...]
Sleeping Mind does not restrict Wake. It only restricts actual untapping
(like Guard Dogs/2nd Tradition) and it prevents tapped minions from
blocking (so the Wakes cannot be used to block,
[....]

--
